data.name: YTMusicUltimate
data.subtitle: Lightweight YouTube Music tweak
data.localizedDescription: YTMusicUltimate is a lightweight enhancer for YouTube Music by Dayanch96. It unlocks background audio playback, removes in-app advertisements, enables premium audio streaming quality, and provides customizable player themes.
data.versionDescription:
YTMusicUltimate 9.37.2 | YTMusic 2.4.1 | YTMusicUltimate_9.37.2_2.4.1

> [!NOTE]
> ### Extra tweaks:
> - Return YouTubeMusic Dislikes
> - YTMABConfig
> - VolumeBoostYT
- - -
- YouMusicPiP is only available in custom build
- iOS14+ build is available in releases page

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Allows access to Apple Music for background playback and media features.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Used for connecting to Bluetooth headphones and audio devices.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used to discover and cast audio to devices on your local network.

compatibility.notes: Official project: dayanch96/YTMusicUltimate. The upstream repo publishes the tweak as a .deb only; this source serves a ready-to-sideload IPA built from the official tweak by the mrdrvt99/YTMusicUltimate build fork. Shares com.google.ios.youtubemusic with MaxMusic: install one at a time.
